name: jobfinder
description: Job discovery and application-tracking pipeline that scrapes postings (via python-jobspy), seeds and sources companies, tracks applications, and exports results, with a TUI dashboard

commands.name: init
commands.description: Create the SQLite DB and apply all migrations

commands.name: pipeline
commands.description: Pipeline operations

commands.name: seeding
commands.description: Seed SourceSeed table from <DATA_DIR>/interests.md via an LLM-driven jobspy call

commands.name: approve-seeds
commands.description: For each SourceSeed name without a matching JobSource, create a JobSource (url left null) and queue sourcing on it. Run `pipeline sourcing` afterwards to discover the URLs.

commands.name: sourcing
commands.description: For every active JobSource with `url IS NULL`, ask the LLM (with web search) for the company URL, verify it by opening the page, and fill it in. By default only queues the selected rows; pass --start to process them now.

options.description: Re-process every qualifying in-scope JobSource regardless of pipeline state. Use after a prompt change.
Also retry rows in failed / aborted / no_result state (default skips them). Mutually exclusive with --all.
Re-process only the JobSource with this ID, regardless of pipeline state or qualification.
Process the selected rows now. Without this flag the command only queues them for a later `--start` or `jobfinder start-pipeline`.

commands.name: listing
commands.description: For each currently-queued JobSource, BFS the company site to find its job-listing page; insert a JobListSource row with a placeholder parserScript (`pipeline scripting` fills it in). By default only queues the selected rows; pass --start to process them now.

options.description: Re-process every qualifying in-scope JobSource regardless of pipeline state. Use after a prompt change.
Also retry rows in failed / aborted / no_result state (default skips them). Mutually exclusive with --all.
Re-process only the JobSource with this ID, regardless of pipeline state or qualification.
Process the selected rows now. Without this flag the command only queues them for a later `--start` or `jobfinder start-pipeline`.

commands.name: scripting
commands.description: Generate and validate a parser script (listLocations + searchJobs) for each currently-queued JobListSource and store it in JobListSource.parserScript. By default only queues the selected rows; pass --start to process them now.

options.description: Re-process every qualifying in-scope JobListSource regardless of pipeline state. Re-scripts done rows and overwrites their parserScript on success. Use after a prompt change.
Also retry rows in failed / aborted / no_result state (default skips them). Mutually exclusive with --all.
Re-process only the JobListSource with this ID, regardless of pipeline state or qualification.
Process the selected rows now. Without this flag the command only queues them for a later `--start` or `jobfinder start-pipeline`.

commands.name: run-scripts
commands.description: For every JobListSource with a validated parserScript, ask the LLM to map the supplied (or interests-derived) division/location to the page filter options, then run searchJobs and insert the matching jobs into JobPost. By default only queues the selected rows; pass --start to process them now.

options.description: Division/department to filter by (e.g. "engineering"). Overrides the value extracted from interests.md.
Location to filter by (e.g. "Toronto, ON"). Overrides the value extracted from interests.md.
Re-process every qualifying in-scope JobListSource regardless of pipeline state. Use after a prompt change.
Also retry rows in failed / aborted / no_result state (default skips them). Mutually exclusive with --all.
Re-process only the JobListSource with this ID, regardless of pipeline state or qualification.
Process the selected rows now. Without this flag the command only queues them for a later `--start` or `jobfinder start-pipeline`.

commands.name: viewing
commands.description: For each currently-queued JobPost, open the URL and ask the LLM to populate title/company/location/description/salary/etc. fields. By default only queues the selected rows; pass --start to process them now.

options.description: Re-view every qualifying in-scope JobPost regardless of pipeline state — including ones already done / not_a_job_posting / failed. Use after a prompt change.
Also retry rows in failed / aborted / no_result state (default skips them). Mutually exclusive with --all.
Re-view only the JobPost with this ID, regardless of pipeline state or qualification.
Process the selected rows now. Without this flag the command only queues them for a later `--start` or `jobfinder start-pipeline`.

commands.name: evaluate
commands.description: For each currently-queued viewed JobPost, score interest + skill against data/interests.md and data/cv.md and upsert the result into JobPostEval. By default only queues the selected rows; pass --start to process them now.

options.description: Re-evaluate every qualifying in-scope JobPost regardless of pipeline state. Use after a prompt change.
Also retry rows in failed / aborted / no_result state (default skips them). Mutually exclusive with --all.
Re-evaluate only the JobPost with this ID, regardless of pipeline state or qualification.
Process the selected rows now. Without this flag the command only queues them for a later `--start` or `jobfinder start-pipeline`.

commands.name: fill-form
commands.description: Generate and store a résumé fill-form script (discoverFields + fillForm) for each currently-queued JobPost and save it in JobPost.fillFormScript. Never submits. This stage is NOT run by `start-pipeline`; queue posts explicitly (e.g. via `jobfinder fill-form <id|url>`). By default only queues the selected rows; pass --start to process them now.

options.description: Re-process every qualifying in-scope JobPost regardless of pipeline state, overwriting fillFormScript on success. Use after a prompt change.
Also retry rows in failed / aborted / no_result state (default skips them). Mutually exclusive with --all.
Re-process only the JobPost with this ID, regardless of pipeline state or qualification.
Process the selected rows now. Without this flag the command only queues them for a later `--start`.

commands.name: reset
commands.description: Requeue tasks in a pipeline stage so the next run reprocesses them. Pick exactly one selector: --all (every in-scope entity), --no-result (entities whose latest state produced no result), or --failed (entities whose latest state is an error).

arguments.name: stage
arguments.description: Pipeline stage whose tasks to requeue.

options.description: Requeue every in-scope entity for the stage, including ones already done. Use after a prompt or config change.
Requeue only entities whose latest state produced no result (e.g. not_a_job_posting, no_listing_found).
Requeue only entities whose latest state is a failure (failed, script_error, aborted).

commands.name: start-pipeline
commands.description: Run sourcing, listing, scripting, run-scripts, viewing, and evaluate concurrently in independent loops until every queue drains. viewing and evaluate are prioritized: the upstream tasks (sourcing/listing/scripting/run-scripts) defer their next iteration while either of those two still has work, so the current backlog is viewed and evaluated before more JobPosts are generated. Each loop sleeps 5s only when its previous iteration found nothing to do.

options.description: Pass --include-failed to each task on its FIRST iteration only — same picker semantics as `jobfinder pipeline <task> --include-failed`, applied once at the start so failed / aborted / no_result rows get retried. Subsequent iterations of each loop run in default queued-only mode so a fresh failure during the run is not retried forever.

Start even if another instance holds this database’s pipeline lock. Only for when you are certain the recorded holder is dead — two live runs double-process every row and make the stale-started reap requeue each other’s in-flight work.

commands.name: export
commands.description: Export pipeline data for use outside the CLI / TUI (CSV, etc.).

commands.name: jobs
commands.description: Export fully-evaluated JobPost rows (status=Done) as CSV — i.e. only posts that cleared the in-scope filter AND have description + interestScore + skillScore + locationScore filled in.

arguments.name: output
arguments.description: Output CSV path. Defaults to ./jobs.out.csv (matches the *.out.csv gitignore so it stays out of version control).

options.description: Sort key (mirrors `jobfinder tui`).

commands.name: track
commands.description: Classify <url> via LLM as a job post / job list / neither. For a job post, enqueue sourcing on the company and viewing on the post. For a job list, enqueue sourcing and listing on the company. Exits non-zero when the URL is neither.

arguments.name: url
arguments.description: URL of a job posting or a careers / jobs index page.

commands.name: job
commands.description: Act on a single job post (identified by its id or url).

commands.name: exclude
commands.description: Manually mark a job post out of scope so the pipeline skips it and the TUI hides it from the default view.

options.description: Note recorded alongside the exclusion.

commands.name: include
commands.description: Reverse a manual exclusion, letting the post re-enter scope (subject to the usual active-tree and relevancy gates).

commands.name: bump
commands.description: Manually prioritize a JobPost so it clears the viewing and evaluate stages ahead of the rest. The pickers order by the bump timestamp (most recently bumped first), so bumping several posts stacks them by recency. Pass --clear to remove the bump.

arguments.name: jobPostId
arguments.description: ID of the JobPost to prioritize (or clear).

options.description: Remove the priority bump on the JobPost instead of adding one.

commands.name: fill-form
commands.description: Open a job application form and auto-fill it from your applicant profile (data/profile.local.md), WITHOUT submitting. Given a JobPost id it fills that post; given a URL it find-or-creates the post (bootstrapping a placeholder company + queuing sourcing/viewing) first. Caches the generated fill script on JobPost.fillFormScript.

arguments.name: jobPostIdOrUrl
arguments.description: A JobPost id, or the URL of a job application form / posting.

options.description: Discard any cached fillFormScript and generate a fresh one.
Generate and store the fill script but do not open the interactive fill.
When given a URL with no existing JobPost, fail instead of creating one.
Force a visible browser for the fill (default).
Run the fill in a headless browser (still screenshots + reports the filled values).
Where to write a screenshot of the filled form. Defaults to <RESUME_OUTPUT_DIR>/fill-form-<jobPostId>.png.

commands.name: tui
commands.description: Open the live dashboard: the pipeline funnel, the JobPost / Sources tables, and a recent-activity feed, all refreshing as the pipeline writes to the DB.

options.description: open the live dashboard and also expose an HTTP control server so an agent can read the screen (GET /screen) and send keystrokes (POST /keys) to the same instance
port for the harness control server (default: an ephemeral free port)

commands.name: completion
commands.description: Generate Zsh completion script (writes __generated__/cli/_completion.zsh and prints to stdout)

commands.name: help-menu-dump
commands.description: Dump the full command tree as JSON (writes __generated__/cli/help-menu.json and prints to stdout)

options.description: Pretty-print JSON (default)
Emit compact JSON
